title: ポニー少女とオオカミ王子

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day as I walk to the movie theater, I spot Mejiro Ryan in the area looking around frantically.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeesh… Where's McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Aaaagh! T-Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Ryan trembles from the shock, some movie ticket stubs fall from her hands. I quickly pick them up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah! Wait, that's…
choice_data_list: "The Pony Girl and the Wolf Prince"?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I believe that's the title of the live-action version of a popular romance manga…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um! Uh, you see, these are just…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen is a fan of the director, you see! So I'm, you know, gonna keep her company—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Apologies for being late! An errand took longer than I anticipated…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You've read the manga several times in anticipation, have you not? Come, let's hurry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wait! McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Uh, anyway! I heard that this is a real classy movie. Very artistic—and inspirational!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Right, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Certainly… We can say that it is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: See! McQueen agrees with me!
choice_data_list: In that case, maybe I should see it too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, uh, that's…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ryan. Now is not the time to be making excuses.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wh-what do you m—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please do Ryan the favor of taking a seat separate from us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At Mejiro McQueen's request, I get a seat a fair distance from them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wowie! It really was as artistic and inspiring as they said!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, it was! And McQueen agrees with me! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh! Yes, of course! Um… that final profession of love, for instance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Right, right! That scene was sooo good!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: When he said, "I'll never let you go," and then, as their lips got closer…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It was so roma—I mean, inspiring! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I make a silent vow to never bring this up again to let Mejiro Ryan save face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah! You're right, we should hurry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew… Thank goodness. I think my trainer bought it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well, if that's what you think, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I end up watching a different movie. Afterward, I exit the theater to find…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It was sooo good! Especially the scene at the end where they reveal their love!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, I understand. Now, do please compose yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And then… you know! The… k-kissing scene!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I would have seen it if I wasn't busy trying to keep you from jumping out of your chair…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Swoon! Oh my gosh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ryan, we should go! What if your trainer were to come back and see you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: O-oh, you're right. I can't let anyone see me like this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: All right. Let's go get some tea and talk more about the movie!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Very well. But only if we return by curfew. Agreed?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Watching them from behind, I vow to myself to never speak of this.
